companyFieldUpdates.description: Bolder Industries is a U.S. circular-materials infrastructure platform that converts end-of-life tires into recovered carbon black, pyrolysis oil, steel and energy for tire, rubber, plastics and other industrial customers. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Boulder, Colorado. Its operating and development footprint includes Maryville, Missouri, Terre Haute, Indiana and Antwerp, Belgium; those facilities and projects are not separate PortCos. CIM was an early investor and expanded its investment in October 2021. Tiger Infrastructure Partners completed a growth investment on February 10, 2025 through a recapitalization in which CIM participated, so Tiger joined rather than replaced CIM. Both sponsors remain current based on manager portfolio and board evidence. Their exact funds, vehicles, stakes and control rights, and CIM's original entry date, are not publicly disclosed. No later platform sale, exit, insolvency or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.

set.event: Bolder Industries was founded as a circular-materials company focused on recovering industrial products from end-of-life tires.
Bolder opened its Maryville, Missouri tire-recycling facility, an operating asset within the platform rather than a separate PortCo.
CIM expanded its existing Bolder investment as the company raised US$80 million of equity and secured US$100 million of committed project funding.

Tiger Infrastructure Partners completed a growth investment in Bolder through a recapitalization in which CIM participated; disclosed sources did not identify the funds, vehicles, stakes or control rights.
Tiger continued to list Bolder as a current investment and CIM retained board representation; no later ownership transfer or signed pending sale was found.
